text:
rachel: During scheduled restore smoke I hit 5 snapshots that fail with KMS AccessDenied. Looks like uploader left cmk metadata blank on these objects.

devops: Yikes. Can you paste the error from the restore job?

rachel: snippet: ```2026-03-21T12:20:03Z ERROR restore: AccessDeniedException: not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/9a8b7c6d-...```

sec_lead: Common failure mode: uploader used an env var for CMK and it was unset in that deploy. Without the manifest cmk_id our restore tool resolves alias -> current key and picks wrong key. Two quick options: 1) create a temporary grant for backup-restorer to the recorded key 2) re-ingest objects with corrected metadata. Temp grant is fastest for recovery.

encops-bot: Incident INC-2026-412 opened (priority=P2) 12 snapshots failing decrypt in prod-backups.

oncall: I'll apply the short-lived grant and hold the uploader rollout. Will post grant ARN.

devops: Grant command to run (example):
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id 9a8b7c6d-... --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111:role/backup-restorer --operations Decrypt --name temp-recover-412
```
Make sure to record GrantId and approval in the incident.

auditor-bot: Reminder: KMS grants must be approved and logged. Temporary grants need justification and expiration plan.

rachel: I'll run restore smoke after grant is created. Also proposing we fail-fast in uploader CI when CMK env var empty: simple shell check: `if [ -z "$CMK_KEY_ID" ]; then exit 1; fi`

sec_lead: Also update snapshot manifest writer to emit `encrypt.key_arn` so restore doesn't rely purely on env heuristics.

oncall: Temp grant created: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:grant/temp-412-xyz. Restores in flight.

rachel: Restore results: snapshots s-20260318-06 and s-20260319-04 restored successfully; one snapshot was partially uploaded and flagged for re-upload. Checksums matched for successful restores.

devops: I'll open a hotfix PR for the uploader CI fail-fast + manifest emission and include unit tests. We'll revoke the temp grant after we confirm no new missing metadata for 24h.

auditor-bot: Security lead (sec_lead) approved the temporary grant in INC-2026-412. Please attach postmortem and policy update before closure.

sec_lead: Root cause: deploy unsetting CMK env var -> missing cmk_id in metadata -> restore misrouted. Remediation: temp grant + uploader CI + manifest field + alert on uploads with empty cmk_id.

rachel: Filing the postmortem draft and runbook edits now. Closing the loop after PR merges and grant revoked. :white_check_mark:
